slides.title: Photosynthesis
slides.subtitle: How Plants Turn Light Into Energy
slides.description: An introduction to the process every green plant uses to survive.

slides.title: The Three Ingredients
slides.subtitle: Every plant needs these to photosynthesize.

items.title: Sunlight
items.desc: Provides the energy that drives the whole reaction.

items.title: Water
items.desc: Absorbed through the roots and split for electrons.

items.title: Carbon Dioxide
items.desc: Taken in through leaf pores and used to build sugar.

steps.title: Light Capture
steps.desc: Chlorophyll in the leaf absorbs sunlight.

steps.title: Water Splitting
steps.desc: Light energy splits water into oxygen and hydrogen.

steps.title: Energy Transfer
steps.desc: Hydrogen and captured energy combine with CO2.

steps.title: Sugar Production
steps.desc: The plant produces glucose it can use or store.

insight.title: The bigger picture
insight.body: Photosynthesis is the foundation of nearly every food chain on Earth and the process that produced the oxygen atmosphere we depend on.

slides.title: Photosynthesis vs. Respiration
slides.subtitle: Two processes that mirror each other.

slides.headline: Quiz Time
slides.body: Test what you've learned about photosynthesis in the next section.
